items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: But he played piano when I first met. He was a young boy.

ctx.x: These people tell you it's a great big secret. It's nothing but march time, syncopated. White man's music and not colored. That's all it is. You take the tiger rank, we'll fit in that. You play. Hold that tiger. Hold that tiger. You can do anything you want with it. It's waking up different embellishments on a chord construction. That's all it is. Now these fellas in New Orleans, they play today. You know who they play? I'm going to let you know who they play. They're great. I was nobody. They play Big…

Mr. LaRock, I'm glad you brought Big's name into this. Because I wanted you to tell us a little more about your relationship with him. In your previous statement, you said you thought he was a very great musician.
Yes. I still think that. But he played piano when I first met. He was a young boy.
